dedupe_keys.name: distributed solar photovoltaic array location and extent collection

description: This research collection maps 19,433 distributed photovoltaic arrays in 601 aerial images covering Fresno, Stockton, Oxnard and Modesto in California. The research team supplies array coordinates and polygon boundaries alongside the USGS imagery used for annotation. Figshare distributes the polygons in GeoJSON, JSON, CSV and MATLAB formats and the images as TIFF with XML metadata. All five collection members state CC0, allowing free reuse. The July 2020 revision corrects reversed pixel-area and square-metre labels in several polygon files; earlier revisions improved georeferencing and removed or corrected erroneous annotations. The own metadata does not provide one common image-acquisition date or positional accuracy for the complete collection. These observations can train array-detection models and construct distributed-generation inventories for electricity-system planning simulations, complementing data-harmonised-global-wind-solar-farm-locations-osm. A caveat is that visible panel area does not by itself determine electrical capacity, output or grid connection. The four-city sample also limits transfer to different roof types, climates and imagery resolutions.
